``````{r detector-engine, include=FALSE}
@@DETECTOR_MODULES@@
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, error = FALSE)
``````

``````{r evidence-report, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
report_result <- analyze_rmd_pair(
  params$input_a, params$input_b,
  text_options = list(k = params$text_k, min_chars = params$text_min_chars,
    min_similarity = params$text_min_similarity),
  formula_options = list(min_steps = params$formula_min_steps,
    max_steps = params$formula_max_steps, max_skips = params$formula_max_skips),
  code_options = list(min_tokens = params$code_min_tokens,
    window_tokens = params$code_window_tokens, max_skips = params$code_max_skips),
  exclusions = if (nzchar(params$exclusion_file)) params$exclusion_file else NULL
)
# 明确作为原始 HTML 输出，避免再次按 Markdown 解析
cat(
  "\n```{=html}\n",
  detector_report_html(report_result, params$max_evidence),
  "\n```\n",
  sep = ""
)
``````
